title: universe.yaml
description: Universe manifest: a layer that relies on two or more base packages and reconciles them with a bridge. See spec/08-crossovers.md §8.1. That every relies-on entry is a base package, and that offsets has one key per base, are host validations (spec §14.2).

version.description: Bumped like a package (spec §2.8) whenever the manifest or bridge changes.

relies-on.description: The base packages the universe composes, pinned.

offsets.description: Per base: how far its calendar is shifted to the universe's. A base with no entry has +0y.
